validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real, TWO independent origins. (1) MEED (industry trade press, the row's own cited source) explicitly lists the EPC package in its MGS-3 package table: 'Laying 20-inch, 16-inch, 12-inch and 4-inch lateral pipelines from Yanbu to Rabigh, covering 192km' — Package 15 of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3; url_verifier OK 200 with exact tokens 'Yanbu','Rabigh','192'. (2) Blackridge Research (independent project-profile database) carries the same Package-15 line 'Yanbu to Rabigh ... 192km' with the 20/16/12/4-inch spec; url_verifier OK 200 with tokens 'Yanbu','Rabigh','192km' — a separate origin, not tracing to MEED or GEM. Program-level corroboration: DMS Projects MGS-3 overview page (names Yanbu/Rabigh package; url_verifier OK 200 for 'Yanbu','Rabigh' though the JS-rendered table did not expose '192' to the fetcher), plus worldoil and OGN News program articles. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: recorded PipelineType=transmission, Fuel=Gas. Gas commodity is correct (MGS = Master Gas System). Caveat: MEED describes Package 15 as 'lateral pipelines' in a mixed small-bore bundle (20/16/12/4-inch), i.e. distribution/lateral spurs feeding power plants rather than a 56-inch east-west transmission trunk like Packages 3-11. Because it is an integral part of the national Master Gas System and GEM classifies the sibling lateral packages (P6732/33/34/37) identically, transmission is defensible and left unchanged — flagged as a caveat, not a concern. DUPLICATE CHECK: Package 15 (Yanbu→Rabigh, 192 km) is unique in the roster. No other in-scope PID shares this route: P6732=Package 12 (116 km, Eastern/Qassim clusters), P6733=Package 13 (470 km, Riyadh cluster), P6734=Package 14 (212 km, Shoaiba), P6737=Package 17 (Jizan, 30/16-inch). MEED names each as a distinct package. Not a double-count. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct — Aramco owns/operates the Master Gas System. Fuel=Gas correct. Endpoints Yanbu (Al Madinah province) → Rabigh (Makkah province) correct per MEED/blackridge; provinces are the standard administrative homes of those cities. Location [ref] was blank (orphan values) — now paired (staged in fills). SPEC: LengthKnown 192 km and Diameter 20,16,12,4 in BOTH explicitly confirmed verbatim by MEED ('20-inch, 16-inch, 12-inch and 4-inch ... covering 192km') and blackridge — no material disagreement, high tier. Capacity blank and left blank: no defensible per-package capacity exists (only the program-wide +3.15 bscfd figure), so not fabricated. StartYear1 2028 matches the program's Q4-2028 completion target.
